concepts.def: Universe expanding from a single point

walkthroughs.body_html:
Distant galaxies show red-shift - wavelengths stretched.

The further away, the bigger the red-shift -> universe expanding.

v = H0 x d.

Linked recession speed to distance -> Big Bang model.

v = 2 pi r / T.

Earth around Sun: r ~ 1.5 x 10^11 m, T = 1 year.

numericals.q: Orbit radius 4 x 10^8 m, period 1 x 10^6 s. v (m/s)?
